notes: Variant unit WLC.ECC.9.4.v001 selects r00-base, which covers s004 `יְחֻבַּר`; the projection is compatible with the ASV's *that is joined* and no new textual decision was made here (rule 9).
The ASV's marginal alternative (*For who is exempted?*) was read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
*to him* is placed on `מִי` under rule 33, the supplied preposition stating the role of a nominal carrying no preposition or marker of its own; the competing reading leaves *to* `added`.
`הוּא` is `unrepresented` because the ASV realizes the resumed subject once and sends the copula to the predicate adjective (rule 20's tripartite clause).
